basic_profile.bio: A comic book enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I have been a lifelong fan of the X-Men and love diving deep into both mainstream and obscure storylines. I work as a graphic designer, allowing me to appreciate the artistry in comics. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work, typically around 7-10 PM PST. In a long-term relationship with a fellow geek, we often spend weekends attending comic conventions or watching the latest superhero films.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been reading comics since I was a teenager, starting with X-Men and expanding to other Marvel and DC titles. My knowledge comes from years of collecting physical issues, as well as participating in online forums and discussions. I also occasionally write reviews for a small comic book blog.
